to him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to…

if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
“Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who…

translations.web: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
translations.bsb: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
translations.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
translations.asv: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.
